whatItIs.title: What it is
whatItIs.body: A milky toner —never watery— inspired by the ritual of fermented rice water. The first step of the NATIVA ritual: it hydrates, soothes, brightens and evens tone. A liquid-silk texture that absorbs with no residue in seconds.

whatItIsNot.title: What it isn't
items: A watery essence with no texture.

sensorial.title: The experience
sensorial.body: A liquid-silk texture that absorbs with no residue in 15–30 seconds. A soft, clean, floral-neutral scent: neither perfumed nor clinical. Freshness followed by calm. The feeling that your skin received something good.

ingredients.title: Ingredients that care
ingredients.subtitle: A serious formula, in sensorial language.

items.name: Fermented rice water
items.note: The star ingredient. Light and tone.

items.name: Ectoin
items.note: Protects against environmental stress and daily damage.

howToUse.title: How to use
steps: Apply to clean skin, with your hands (palming) or a cotton pad.
Continue your ritual. Morning and night.

manifesto.title: I couldn't find the brand I was looking for. So we formulated it.
manifesto.intro: NATIVA is born from a simple truth: Latin women deserved premium skincare that understood our skin, our climate and our story — without apologizing for where we come from.

bridge.title: The bridge
bridge.body: Inherited Latin American ritual times Korean cosmetic precision. The sensorial, emotional world of our grandmothers, with the rigor of a modern formulation. Science with soul.

values.title: Intimate
values.body: We speak like a friend who knows more about skincare than you. Close, never condescending.

values.title: Sensorial
values.body: We describe texture, scent and feel before ingredients. Skin is felt, not just treated.

values.title: Sure of our roots
values.body: We don't apologize for being Latin. Premium with roots, not an ethnic brand.

woman.title: The NATIVA woman
woman.body: She lives between cultures, or with a global sensibility. She cares for her skin with intention and values the story behind the product. The Bicultural, the Conscious Latina, the Open Beauty.

manifesto.closing: We don't want to sell thousands. We want the first 100 customers who want to come back.
